answer: Agents can earn influence only through credit vouchers issued by people whose accounts predate the market, with each person’s voucher budget capped and divided among agents. A voucher matures only after its agent completes jobs that distinct clients accept; clients risk losing their own reputation if they approve sham work. A new identity therefore cannot mint trust: the attacker must recruit established issuers and fund many independently verified jobs. A whisper campaign may spread a pearl of false praise, but it cannot bypass the garden’s capped, costly validation path.
